RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the March 1, 2002/Phalguna 10, 1923 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Agriculture; Chemicals and Fer tilizers; Environment and
Forests; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean
Development; Railways; Science and Technology; Steel;
Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions—155
39
Upgrading the quality of foodgrains
156. SHRI MAN MOHAN SAMAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) what are the various surplus crops
which were available for exports during
the last year;
(b) whether it is a fact that Indian
foodgrains are graded as substandard in
the international market;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the measures taken so far, for
producing  quality foodgrains?
Cattle population in Orissa
157. SHRI MAN MOHAN SAMAL:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Orissa has lost a huge cattle population
due to three consecutive natural
calamities;
(b) if so, whether Government have
assessed the total losses in terms of meat,
milk and other animal products during the
last two years;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government have any
agenda for increasing the cattle population
in Orissa; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Industrial status to agricultural
sector
158. SHRI NABAM REBIA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have a
proposal to give  industrial status to the
agricultural sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Co-operative societies in Arunachal
Pradesh
159. SHRI NABAM REBIA : Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of co-operative
societies functioning at present in
Arunachal Pradesh;
(b) the details of financial assistance
provided by Government to them during
the last three years; and

Incentives to farmers
160. SHRI NABAM REBIA : Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
announce any incentives to agricultural
farmers in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Poultry organisations in Andhra
Pradesh
161. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that none of the
Central Poultry Development
Organisations set up  by Government is
located in Andhra Pradesh, though the
State leads in  poultry farming in the
country;
(b) if so, the reasons for ignoring the
State; and
(c) the remedial measures proposed to
be taken in this regard?
Agricultural Technology Information
Centres in Punjab
†162. SHRIMATI GURCHARAN
KAUR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) the district-wise details of
Agricultural Technology Information
Centres set up in Punjab;
(b) the details of expenditure incurred
by Government during the last three years
for the purpose in the State; and
(c) the necessary action taken by
Government to impart training to farmers
in the State?
Assistance to Andhra Pradesh for
floods and cyclone
163. DR. Y. LAKSHMI PRASAD:
SHRI SOLIPET A RAMA-
CHANDRA REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to refer to answer to Unstarred
Question 1967, given in the Rajya Sabha
on the 7th December, 2001 and state:
(a) whether Government have
considered the report of the Central Team
which visited Andhra Pradesh to assess
the damage caused by floods and cyclone;
(b) if so, the Central assistance given
to that State in view of the damage caused
by floods and cyclone last year;
(c) the additional assistance demanded
by the State; and
(d) the action taken thereon?
Integration of disaster mitigation and
developmental planning in Gujarat
164. SHRI NARENDRA MOHAN:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether, having taken stock of
relief and rehabilitation measures for a
year in the earthquake ravaged Gujarat,
there is an urgent need to integrate disaster
mitigation with development planning
which should include the needs of the
most vulnerable sections of the society;
(b) if so, whether Government are
thinking of evolving such an integrated
programme; and
(c) if so, what are the details thereof?

Diversification of crops, livestock and
fisheries in A.P.
165. SHRI SOLIPETA RAMA-
CHANDRA REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Andhra Pradesh
Government has approached the Union
Government  to extend full support and
provide funds for its efforts to diversify
crops, livestock and fishery enterprises,
to match the emerging demand patterns;
(b) if so, the details of the requirements
of the State in this regard; and
(c) whether necessary funds have been
released;
